fields.doc: Original expected first tsunami arrival time from the JMA detail bulletin preserving its local offset when available.

items.doc: Coastal forecast region item parsed from a JMA tsunami detail bulletin when active tsunami information is available. It preserves region identity, per-region tsunami category, expected first-arrival time, and expected maximum wave height when those fields appear in VTSE detail JSON.

fields.doc: Coastal forecast regions and expected wave/arrival data parsed from VTSE41 tsunami detail bulletins. AffectedCoastalRegion is defined inline to avoid duplicate schema definitions during Avro and producer generation.

fields.name: observations

items.name: JP.JMA.Tsunami.TsunamiAlert_types.observations_item

fields.name: station_code
fields.doc: JMA observation station code from the observed tsunami bulletin when the station entry exposes a code; null is emitted for text-only station entries.

fields.name: station_name_jp
fields.doc: Japanese tsunami observation station name from the observed-wave bulletin.

fields.name: station_name_en
fields.doc: English observation station name when supplied by JMA or mapped by the bridge; null when the upstream bulletin only contains Japanese station text.

fields.name: observed_max_wave_height_m
fields.doc: Observed maximum tsunami wave height at the station in meters. Null is emitted for qualitative or not-yet-available observed-wave entries. JSON Structure annotations: {"minimum": 0, "symbol": "m", "unit": "meter"}

fields.name: observed_at
fields.doc: Observed wave time converted to RFC3339 UTC when the station entry includes an observation time.

fields.name: observed_at_local
fields.doc: Original observed wave time preserving the local offset when available in the station entry.

fields.name: arrival_status
fields.doc: Normalized observation lifecycle for station wave entries: ESTIMATED for expected or pending arrivals, FIRST_WAVE_OBSERVED when the first wave has arrived, and MAX_WAVE_OBSERVED when a maximum wave height is reported. JSON Structure annotations: {"descriptions": {"ESTIMATED": "Provider value `ESTIMATED` for this coded alert field.", "FIRST_WAVE_OBSERVED": "Provider value `FIRST_WAVE_OBSERVED` for this coded alert field.", "MAX_WAVE_OBSERVED": "Provider value `MAX_WAVE_OBSERVED` for this coded alert field."}, "enum": ["ESTIMATED", "FIRST_WAVE_OBSERVED", "MAX_WAVE_OBSERVED"]}

items.doc: Observed tsunami station measurement parsed from JMA VTSE51/VTSE52 observed-wave bulletins and embedded in the alert revision that carries the same event id and serial. Keeping observations inside TsunamiAlert preserves one generated top-level dataclass and one {event_id}/{serial} Kafka identity for all tsunami bulletin revisions.

fields.doc: Observed tsunami station readings parsed from VTSE51/VTSE52 observed-wave detail bulletins. The bridge emits an empty array for forecast-only bulletins or when no station observations are present.

fields.name: prefecture
fields.doc: ASCII-safe Japan region routing axis for tsunami MQTT/AMQP topics. JSON Structure annotations: {"pattern": "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$"}

fields.name: severity
fields.doc: Japan-native tsunami warning severity axis: advisory, warning, or emergency. JSON Structure annotations: {"descriptions": {"advisory": "Tsunami advisory or forecast-level routing severity.", "emergency": "Major tsunami warning routing severity.", "warning": "Tsunami warning routing severity."}, "enum": ["advisory", "warning", "emergency"]}

schema.doc: JMA Bosai active tsunami alert telemetry from list.json enriched with detail bulletin coastal forecasts.

description: JMA Bosai Warnings publishes weather warnings and advisories from the Japan Meteorological Agency for Japanese weather-warning areas. These events help consumers monitor hazards, route notifications, and correlate public-warning updates without polling the upstream source directly.

documentation.description: Source documentation for JMA Bosai Warnings, including upstream feed context and bridge deployment notes.
